title: Fetch PR check runs from GitHub
spec: Add a client method that fetches check runs for a commit. Close every response body, limit reads to 1 MiB and return an error for non-200 responses.
acceptance_criteria: every response body is closed, including on error paths
non-200 responses return an error that includes the status code
response reads are limited to 1 MiB

defects.note: the body is not closed on the non-200 path; defer Close is only set after the status check
